wiki_item: #8 Dynamic music (Dimension 2 -- tense low-drone crossfade on threatTier>=2)
binary_acceptance: Music swaps to the tension track during a raid (threatTier>=2) and back when clear.

scene_wiring_flag.qa_action: Wire dangerBgm in the AudioBank GameObject Inspector (SceneSetup.Game.Audio.cs ForceImport pattern, same as sfxBuild/sfxAlert/sfxAmbient/sfxMine/rainLoop). Wiki #8 cannot verify without this wire.

summary: AudioBank.cs extended with dangerBgm AudioClip + dangerSource AudioSource (4th, 2D, loop, starts vol=0) + PlayDangerMusic()/StopDangerMusic() that crossfade over ~1s using Time.unscaledDeltaTime (pause-safe). Both methods are idempotent (_dangerActive guard) and graceful null no-ops if dangerBgm/sources unassigned. NEW MusicDirector.cs self-attaches via [RuntimeInitializeOnLoadMethod(AfterSceneLoad)] (DontDestroyOnLoad hidden GO, FindFirstObjectByType guard), mirrors RainSoundDriver pattern exactly. Polls AIDirector.Instance.CurrentThreatTier with _lastTier=-1 sentinel state guard (only acts on transitions). tier>=2 -> PlayDangerMusic(); tier<2 -> StopDangerMusic(). Null-safe for both singletons. NEW danger.wav: 44100Hz mono 16-bit, 16.0s, peak=0.700, tense low-drone (55/82.5/110Hz minor-5th + vibrato) + AM shimmer + 4 slow percussive hits, cosine-fade loop boundary.
